exposure: History of physical trauma during pregnancy
cohort: 441 deliveries at Debreberhan Referral Hospital, Ethiopia, from April to June 2016, including 147 cases with low birth weight and 294 controls with normal birth weight
finding: Preterm birth, history of physical trauma during pregnancy, and history of pregnancy complications were significant predictors of low birth weight.
mod_finding: Cesarean and instrumental delivery were associated with a reduced risk of low birth weight.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (cases): 1000-2400 grams, median 2200 grams; Normal birth weight (controls): 2500-4500 grams, median 3100 grams
